title_en: Guiding Case No. 243: Deng v. Nanchuan District Public Security Bureau, Chongqing — compensation for injury caused by illegal use of weapons

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 243

Deng v. Public Security Bureau of Nanchuan District, Chongqing — compensation for injury caused by allegedly illegal use of weapons

(Discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, published on December 23, 2024)

Keywords

State compensation; compensation for injury caused by illegal use of weapons; endangering life safety; performing duties in accordance with law; use of weapons and police implements; no compensation

Ruling Gist

Where a people's police officer, in the course of performing their duties in accordance with law, uses a weapon to stop a violent crime, and keeps such use within the necessary and reasonable limit to minimize casualties and property losses, such use does not constitute "illegal use of weapons." If a person applies for state compensation on the ground that a people's police officer illegally used a weapon causing bodily injury to a citizen, the people's court shall not support such application in accordance with law.

Basic Facts

At approximately midnight on June 23, 2014, the Public Security Bureau of Nanchuan District, Chongqing, received a report from Yang Mouzhong claiming that Deng had overturned his barbecue stall located near the Agricultural Bank in Nanping Town of that district, and requesting that officers be dispatched. After discovering that Yang had reported him to the police, Deng chased Yang with a knife, hacking at him. While fleeing, Yang fell, and Deng attempted to slash at the fallen Yang, but Yang evaded the attack. When Officer Li and Assistant Zhang arrived at the scene, they saw Deng chasing Yang with a knife and hacking at him. They ordered Deng to drop the knife. Deng stopped chasing Yang but did not drop the knife. Officer Li ordered Deng again to drop the knife, but Deng refused to comply. After Assistant Zhang's attempt to disarm him failed, and Officer Li fired a warning shot, Deng still did not cease his harmful conduct. Instead, he advanced with the knife toward Officer Li and Assistant Zhang. After Officer Li repeatedly ordered Deng to drop the knife to no avail, he shot and wounded Deng in the leg.

On June 23, 2014, the public security authority determined that the knife carried by Deng was a controlled weapon. On June 25 of the same year, the Public Security Bureau of Nanchuan District, Chongqing, decided to file a criminal case against Deng on suspicion of affray. On December 11 of the same year, Deng's injury was diagnosed as a Class 10 disability.

Deng applied for state compensation to the Public Security Bureau of Nanchuan District, Chongqing, which decided, after review, not to grant compensation. Deng filed a reconsideration application, and the Chongqing Public Security Bureau, after reconsideration, rendered the Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision Yu Gong Pei Fu Jue Zi [2015] No. 23, sustaining the decision of the Public Security Bureau of Nanchuan District not to grant compensation. Dissatisfied, Deng applied to the Compensation Committee of the Third Intermediate People's Court of Chongqing for a compensation decision.

Judgment

On March 10, 2016, the Compensation Committee of the Third Intermediate People's Court of Chongqing rendered the State Compensation Decision (2015) Yu San Zhong Fa Wei Pei Zi No. 7, sustaining the Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision Yu Gong Pei Fu Jue Zi [2015] No. 23 of the Chongqing Public Security Bureau. Dissatisfied, Deng filed a petition. On December 20, 2016, the Compensation Committee of the Chongqing High People's Court issued the Notice of Rejection of Petition (2016) Yu Wei Pei Jian No. 33, rejecting Deng's petition.

Reasoning

Article 9 of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Use of Police Implements and Weapons by the People's Police (hereinafter referred to as the "Regulations") provides: "Where a people's police officer determines that an emergency situation involving any of the following violent criminal acts exists, and a warning is ineffective, they may use a weapon: ... (10) using violent means to resist or obstruct a people's police officer from performing their duties in accordance with law, or violently attacking a people's police officer, endangering the life safety of the people's police officer." In this case, after receiving the dispatch assignment, Officer Li of the Public Security Bureau of Nanchuan District, Chongqing, and Assistant Zhang arrived at the scene and witnessed Deng chasing another person with a knife and hacking at them. At that time, Officer Li had the statutory duty to stop Deng's unlawful conduct. Deng, having created a disturbance without cause, chased and hacked at another person with a knife, an act that had already seriously endangered that person's life safety. When Officer Li and Assistant Zhang arrived at the scene, Deng refused to obey their orders. Even after hearing the warning shot, he still advanced with the knife toward Officer Li and Assistant Zhang, and was subsequently shot and wounded by Officer Li. Considering the circumstances of the incident, Deng's conduct had already endangered the life safety of the police officers performing their duties, and therefore Officer Li was permitted to use a weapon. Article 4 of the Regulations provides: "People's police officers using police implements and weapons shall adhere to the principle of stopping unlawful and criminal acts while minimizing casualties and property losses." When using the weapon, Officer Li avoided Deng's vital areas, and after Deng was shot and crouched down, at which point control could be achieved, Officer Li ceased firing. It is evident that Officer Li's use of the weapon did not exceed the necessary limit, complied with the principle of proportionality, and did not violate the provisions of the aforementioned Regulations.

Article 17 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where any organ exercising investigatory, prosecutorial, or judicial powers, or any administrative organ of a detention center or prison, or any functionary thereof, while exercising their functions and powers, infringes upon personal rights in any of the following circumstances, the victim has the right to obtain compensation: ... (5) illegally using weapons or police implements, causing bodily injury or death to a citizen." Since Officer Li's act of firing the weapon was not illegal, Deng's request for state compensation does not meet the provisions of the aforementioned law, and the Public Security Bureau of Nanchuan District, Chongqing, should not bear compensation liability. The Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision rendered by the Chongqing Public Security Bureau has clear findings of fact and correctly applied the law, and is therefore sustained in accordance with law.

Relevant Legal Provisions

Article 17 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China

Article 9 of the Regulations of the People's Republic of China on the Use of Police Implements and Weapons by the People's Police
